title: The Power of the Word of God
opening: God’s Word teaches, corrects, equips, and reveals the condition of our hearts. Spiritual strength grows as we hear it, understand it, and live it.
points: Read Scripture carefully in its context rather than using isolated phrases.
Allow the Word to correct your attitude as well as encourage your heart.
Put what you learn into practice through love, integrity, forgiveness, and obedience.
reflection: What is one teaching from Scripture you can practise today?
prayer: Lord, give me understanding and a willing heart. Let Your Word shape my thoughts, choices, and conduct. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
